editorial.blurb: Reno is a beloved neighborhood gem serving exceptional pizza with perfectly crispy dough, fresh toppings, and an impressive cocktail program in a fun, eclectic space.
editorial.insiderTip: Pizza isn't served until after 4 PM, so plan your visit accordingly—but know that the wait is worth it. Arrive early to grab a seat at the bar and watch VHS movies while you sip a cocktail.
